user.title: Connect your Wolt account
user.description: Paste a Wolt refresh token. Get it from a login nothing else will keep using: open a private window, log in at wolt.com, copy the refresh-token cookie from DevTools → Application → Cookies, then close the private window. Wolt rotates this token on every use and only the newest copy stays valid, so a browser that keeps refreshing it would log Home Assistant out.

reauth_confirm.title: Wolt needs a new login
reauth_confirm.description: Wolt rejected the stored refresh token. Log in again in a private window, copy the new refresh-token cookie, close the window and paste the value here.

error.invalid_auth: Wolt rejected this token. Copy a fresh one from a new private-window login.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wolt. Check the connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Wolt account is already set up.

data.close_distance_m: Close when the courier is within (metres)
data.idle_interval: Poll interval with no active order (seconds)
data.active_interval: Poll interval while the order is being prepared (seconds)
data.courier_interval: Poll interval while the courier is en route (seconds)

reply.name: Reply to support
reply.description: Sends a message from you into the open Wolt support conversation (the one about the active order). Nothing is sent unless this service is called.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to send, as you want the agent to read it.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: Converse conversation id. Defaults to the open conversation the integration follows.

mark_read.name: Mark support messages read
mark_read.description: Sends read receipts for the unread agent messages in the followed conversation, which turns the Support unread sensor off.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: Converse conversation id. Defaults to the followed conversation.

rate.name: Rate a delivered order
rate.description: Submits the two-step rating (food, then delivery) for the delivered order that is waiting for one, exactly as given. A step without a rating is sent as skipped. Nothing is rated unless this service is called.

food_rating.name: Food rating
food_rating.description: 1 (worst) to 5 (best); the labels are in the Rating pending sensor's food_ratings attribute.

food_tags.name: Food tags
food_tags.description: Optional tags from the food_tags attribute for that rating, by name.

food_comment.name: Food comment
food_comment.description: Optional free text for the venue.

delivery_rating.name: Delivery rating
delivery_rating.description: 1 (worst) to 5 (best); labels in the delivery_ratings attribute.

delivery_tags.name: Delivery tags
delivery_tags.description: Optional tags from the delivery_tags attribute for that rating, by name.

delivery_comment.name: Delivery comment
delivery_comment.description: Optional free text about the delivery.

purchase_id.name: Order
purchase_id.description: Wolt purchase id. Defaults to the order waiting for a rating.

dismiss_rating.name: Dismiss the rating prompt
dismiss_rating.description: Closes the rating prompt for the delivered order without rating it (the same as closing it in the app).

purchase_id.name: Order
purchase_id.description: Wolt purchase id. Defaults to the order waiting for a rating.
